Name: Auto Barn and Coop Doors
Author: ckaracin
Description:
🏛️ AUTO BARN AND COOP DOORS(Stardew Valley 1.6+ Quality of Life)[b]Version: 1.2.0
[/b]
Tired of manually opening and closing your barn and coop doors every single day? [b]Auto Barn and Coop Doors[/b] is a lightweight, efficient, and fully customizable mod that takes that chore off your hands, so you can focus on more important farm work!

✨ Key Features
[list]
[*][b]Automatic Opening:[/b] Doors open at your preferred time (Default: [b]06:00 AM[/b]).
[*][b]Automatic Closing:[/b] Doors close safely at your preferred time (Default: [b]07:00 PM[/b]).
[*][b]Smart Weather & Season Logic:[/b] By default, doors stay closed during [b]Rain, Storms, and Winter[/b] to keep your animals happy and warm.
[*][b]Safe Close (New in v1.2.0):[/b] Doors will only close if all animals are safely inside, ensuring no one gets locked out at night.
[*][b]Global Scan (New in v1.2.0):[/b] Manages doors across all maps, including the Farm, Ginger Island, and modded locations (SVE, etc.).
[*][b]Instant Sync (New in v1.2.0):[/b] Changes made in the config menu are applied immediately without needing to restart the game.
[*][b]Festival Protection (New in v1.2.0):[/b] Even if you return late from festivals, the mod ensures doors are handled correctly based on the current time.
[*][b]Notifications & Sounds (New in v1.2.0):[/b] Optional HUD messages and door creak sound effects when doors operate.
[*][b]Building Level Tiers:[/b] Choose when to automate! You can set the mod to only work on specific building levels (e.g., only for [b]Deluxe[/b] buildings).
[*][b]Pro Time Format:[/b] Configuration menu displays time in a clear [b]07:00[/b] format instead of raw numbers.
[/list]⚙️ Configuration

If you have [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b] installed, you can easily customize these settings in-game:

[list]
[*][b]Min Building Level:[/b] Set the minimum level required for automation (1: Normal, 2: Big, 3: Deluxe).
[*][b]Open Time:[/b] Choose exactly when the doors slide open (formatted as HH:mm).
[*][b]Close Time:[/b] Choose exactly when the doors shut for the night.
[*][b]Open in Winter:[/b] Enable if you want your animals out in the snow.
[*][b]Open in Rain:[/b] Enable for those rainy day explorers.
[*][b]Enable Safe Close:[/b] Toggle the animal check before closing.
[*][b]Show Notifications:[/b] Toggle HUD messages for door status.
[*][b]Play Sound:[/b] Toggle the door creak sound effect.
[/list]🌐 Supported LanguagesThe mod automatically detects your game language and adapts:

[list]
[*]English, Türkçe, Deutsch, Español, Français, Italiano, Magyar, 日本語, 한국어, Português, Русский, 简体中文.
[/list]🛠️ Requirements[list=1]
[*][b]SMAPI[/b] (v4.0.0+)
[*][b]Stardew Valley[/b] (v1.6.0+)
[*][b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b] (Optional but highly recommended for easy in-game settings).

[/list]📦 Installation[list=1]
[*]Download the latest version ([b]v1.2.0[/b]).

[*]Extract the [code]AutoBarnCoopDoors[/code] folder into your [code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code] directory.

[*]Ensure the [code]i18n[/code] folder is present inside the mod folder.

[*]Launch the game using SMAPI.

[/list]✅ Compatibility[list]
[*]Fully compatible with [b]Stardew Valley 1.6+[/b].
[*]Works in [b]Single-player and Multiplayer[/b] (Host needs the mod).
[*]Compatible with [b]Stardew Valley Expanded (SVE)[/b] and most custom barn/coop mods.
[/list]Developer: VaultBoy

Happy farming!
